experience, together with proven understanding of

Special technical skills or expertise:
Demonstrate significant knowledge and achievement in either business,
finance, audit, law, technology, governance, strategy, management or other
fields important to the operations of the Group. The combined experience of
the directors of the board is expected to exhibit these competencies.
